1 05-06-2023 Heard Mr. N. J. Dutta, learned counsel for the petitioners and Mr. R. R. Kaushik,
learned Additional Public Prosecutor, Assam for the State.

By this application under Section 438 CrPC, the petitioners, namely, 1) Aynul Haque and 2) Bijuli Barman apprehending their arrest is seeking pre arrest bail in Dispur P.S. Case No. 832/2023 registered under Section 498A IPC corresponding to G.R. No.3384/2023.
List this matter on 14.06.2023 enabling the learned Additional Public Prosecutor, Assam to place the relevant case diary pertaining to said Dispur P.S. Case No. 832/2023.

Till then (i.e., 14.06.2023), in the interim, in the event of arrest of the petitioner No.2, namely, Bijuli Barman in said Dispur P.S. Case No. 832/2023, she shall be released on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs. 35,000/-, with two local sureties of the like amount to the satisfaction of the arresting authority on conditions that the petitioner shall - (i) appear before the Investigating Officer of Dispur P.S. Case No. 832/2023 on or before 08.06.2023 during the office hours and thereafter, as and when she is required for necessary investigation of said Dispur P.S. Case; (ii) not leave the territorial jurisdiction of the Dispur Police Station, without obtaining prior written permission from the concerned Investigating Officer of the case; (iii) not hamper with the investigation, or tamper with the evidence of the case and (iv) shall not, directly or indirectly, make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case, so as to dissuade them from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer.
Page No.# 3/3 Any violation of the aforesaid terms and condition by the petitioner No.2, namely,
Bijuli Barman, the interim pre arrest bail granted to her in the aforementioned Dispur P.S. Case No.
832/2023 shall stand automatically vacated.
